title: A route-mode stdio server that ignores the base URL or probes the broker

behaviours.server_does: connect to api.example.com:443 itself and send Authorization: Bearer $EXAMPLE_API_KEY

expect.result: EPERM from the sandbox profile (only the broker port is reachable)

behaviours.server_does: GET https://evil.example/ HTTP/1.1 sent to the broker port

behaviours.residual: R10: query strings are not scoped by the route.

behaviours.server_does: print os.environ and sys.argv as the tool result
KERN_PROCARGS2 on the supervisor and on itself
behaviours.note: T5 owns this probe; T7 reuses it and adds nothing new.

legacy_environment_grant.expect: unchanged: the server still reads the real value (validate_connector_auth.py:143); credential_exposure is environment_readable_by_local_commands

required: A route-mode server holds only the placeholder and the base URL; reaching anything but its own broker route fails visibly with EPERM, 403, 404 or 405 and never reaches upstream; the legacy environment grant keeps its behaviour and its exposure label.
